hook: Laser scanning and diamond magnetometry image the modes of a 33-resonator superconducting lattice.

readout.label: Bound on relative on-site frequency disorder

summary: Laser scanning microscopy images the eigenmodes of a honeycomb array of 33 resonators, while nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry maps the local microwave magnetic field. Together they confirm the lattice matches its design, show a topological edge state with measured sublattice polarization, and bound on-site frequency disorder at about 0.3 percent. It is one device, and the bound is an upper limit.
title: Eigenmode and field imaging of a compact superconducting resonator array
